trainer/30069.htm.text: Magister Rollant: Becoming a Wizard is no easy feat. The most important thing is to surrender your heart to the bountiful energy of nature and draw it in. Until you do, you won't be able to learn anything. Dion is a particularly good place to learn these lessons...

trainer/30069-noteach.htm.text: Magister Rollant: Magic is not slight of hand. It is a profound philosophy, a deep art. Since you have already taken another path, it would be too much for you to understand the meaning of magic. Go to your own Master.

Q00330_AdeptOfTaste/30069-01.html.text: Magister Rollant: That you want to use monster eye meat, one of the eight ingredients of magical studies, in cooking ... What a unique idea. I am becoming curious myself as to what the result will be. Very well. I will assist you in finding monster eye meat. If you hunt the monster eye and bring ba…

Please bring me ritron fruit from dire wolves , moon flowers from Kadif werewolves , giant mist Leech Fluids and Antidote . Bring them to me and I'll make you the best dessert ever made... Even Magister Mirien, known as the magician of flav…

Q00380_BringOutTheFlavorOfIngredients/30.text: Magister Rollant: Now I must distill the leech fluid and mix it with gelatin. Hmm, I forgot, I need to make gelatin, too. Please light the fire. Now I will crush one ritron fruit and add it to the ground moon flower... Please come back later.

Magister Rollant: Timing is essential! I will add the sterilized Leech Fluids to the ritron fruit just before it melts, so it will develop the maximum smoothness while retaining the pulp that uniquely tickles the throat... I must concentrate. Please don't interrupt me! Come back later!
Magister Rollant: Quiet! This is a very crucial moment! Come back later. Why are you in such a hurry?

Magister Rollant: It's done! Now, it must marinate in the ritron sauce. When it's hardened you can eat it. I call it "Rollant's Special Ritron Jelly". Can you taste the hint of moon flower? Q00380_BringOutTheFlavorOfIngredients/30.text: Magister Rollant: The most important skill a chef possesses is the ability to evaluate fine ingredients. A thorough knowledge of ingredients and the ability to find them are essential. Only then does preparation come into play. Remember, an apple requires no preparation whatsoever. Cooking shouldn'…

Magister Rollant: Raw foods can have a very strong flavor. Some foods, if not prepared properly, can even cause illness. By far, the greatest use of ingredients is dessert. Would you care to sample some?

Magister Rollant: Excellent! We must gather the ingredients! Actually, that will be the hardest part. They aren't easy to find... The fruit of the ritron trees quite often fails to sprout, and ripens underground. Dire wolves have an excellent sense of smell and often dig up the ritron fruits . I wi…

Magister Rollant: Dire wolves can be found in the northern Dion Hills, or in the south across the river west of Dion Castle and also on the Plains of Dion. Magister Rollant: I'm glad you enjoyed it. In case you ever want to have it again, take this recipe . I hope other chefs learn that such ingredients exist and start creating dishes made from them. Please share it with as many people as possible.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
